description: This file defines various linear and identity modules for neural networks in PyTorch, including classes like Identity, Linear, NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear, Bilinear, and LazyLinear, with associated methods and initializations.

classes.name: Identity
classes.description: A placeholder identity operator that returns the input unchanged.

classes.name: Linear
classes.description: Applies an affine linear transformation to the input with learnable weights and bias.

classes.name: NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear
classes.description: A subclass of Linear to avoid errors with improperly quantized attention layers.

classes.name: Bilinear
classes.description: Applies a bilinear transformation to two inputs.

classes.name: LazyLinear
classes.description: A linear module where in_features are inferred at first call, using lazy initialization.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the forward pass for the respective module.

methods.name: reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes or resets the module's parameters.

methods.name: initialize_parameters
methods.description: Infers in_features from input and initializes parameters accordingly (LazyLinear).
